user.title: Hoval CAN
user.description: Connect to your Hoval WLAN gateway (CAN-BUS TCP stream, port 3113).

data_description.host: IP address of the Hoval WLAN gateway on your local network.
data_description.port: TCP port of the CAN-BUS stream (default: 3113).

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect. Check the IP address and that the device is reachable on port 3113.

data.cooling_power_w: Passive Cooling Power (W) — legacy, no longer used in Total Electrical Power

data_description.heater_power_kw: Rated power of the electric DHW immersion heater (Heizstab). Common values: 2.0, 3.0, 6.0 kW. Default: 3.0 kW. Check the unit data plate. COP is calculated automatically from live sensor data and is not configurable here.
data_description.cooling_power_w: Kept for backward compatibility of its own history. No longer added to Total Electrical Power/Energy — the brine and heating-circuit pump power below now cover the same pumps during passive cooling.
data_description.source_temp_c: Ground-loop (brine) entering-fluid temperature. There is no CAN datapoint for this — adjust manually as the ground temperature shifts seasonally. Default 12.5 °C.
data_description.brine_pump_power_w: Ground-loop circulation pump power. Runs whenever the compressor is active or during passive cooling. Same class of high-efficiency pump as the heating-circuit pump per Hoval's spec sheet — treat as an estimate unless measured. Default 30 W.
data_description.heating_pump_power_w: Heating-circuit circulation pump power. Same trigger as the brine pump. Nameplate dynamic range is 4-40 W; default is the median, 20 W.
data_description.standby_power_w: Baseline standby draw (controller electronics + 3-way valve actuator) — always added while the unit is powered, independent of heat pump/DHW/cooling state. Default 12 W.
